universalConverterRules.title: Missing sprite pre-flight check
universalConverterRules.description: Before emitting 'sprite-frame' kind for any CSS background-image or background gradient element, the converter MUST verify the target sprite file exists in assets/resources/sprites/. If the file does not exist: fall back to 'gradient-rect' (linear approximation of dominant gradient axis), set _assetStatus: 'bake-needed', and flag in geometry-correction-log.

universalConverterRules.title: Multi-radial-gradient linear approximation
universalConverterRules.description: When CSS contains multi-stop radial-gradient + linear-gradient composite backgrounds, extract the dominant linear base stops and map to closest design tokens. Mark intermediate radial glows as 'deferred layers' in the skin slot's _converterNote. Use tools_node/lib/dom-to-ui/token-registry.js distance function to select tokens.

universalConverterRules.title: JS-generated elements require alternative detection
universalConverterRules.description: Static HTML processed by puppeteer may not hydrate React useEffect or inline JS. Before concluding an element is absent, check: (1) static HTML source for inline JS arrays, (2) React component source for JSX tab definitions. Register absent JS-generated elements as art-authority diffs if runtime sprites are verified to exist.
